scientific_integrity: The infinite assertions have elementary mathematical proofs; separate finite exact-arithmetic checks corroborate specified cases. Unreviewed claims of independent validation or publication priority are not made.
scientific_limitations: The rank and nonvanishing theorem applies to odd half-length at least three. Exact signed multiplier multiplicities and sharp finite condition numbers are stated only for odd prime half-lengths; general odd half-lengths have a positive universal gap bound and a sharp asymptotic, not exact extrema. Finite tests do not prove the infinite theorem. Priority assessment is bounded by reviewed accessible literature.
title: Full Fourier support of balanced primitive binary words at odd half-length
